WELCOME TO
SKUKUZA SAFARI LODGE
The Epitome of Luxury and Adventure
Located within the renowned Skukuza Rest Camp in Kruger National Park. Our lodge is your gateway to the ultimate bush escape, where you can immerse yourself in the untamed beauty of the African wilderness while enjoying luxurious comforts and unrivalled biodiversity.
With 128 remarkable rooms, including family rooms and opulent suites, our lodge epitomises luxury and offers an unparalleled experience for every guest. Whether you re traveling with family, friends, or on a solo adventure, we have the perfect accommodation to suit your needs.
During your stay, embark on exhilarating game drives and guided safari tours that allow you to explore diverse landscapes and encounter captivating wildlife.
After your adventures, indulge in our finest amenities. Unwind at the elegant bar, where you can savour your favourite drink and share stories with fellow travellers. Delight your taste buds with exquisite cuisine at our restaurant, offering a range of delectable options. And when you need to cool off and relax, take a refreshing dip in our inviting pool, surrounded by the tranquil atmosphere of the lodge.
Our dedicated team is passionate about providing exceptional service and ensuring that every aspect of your stay exceeds your expectations. Experience the epitome of luxury and adventure at Skukuza Safari Lodge. Book your stay now and prepare yourself for an unparalleled safari experience that will leave you with cherished memories of your time in Kruger National Park.

EXPERIENCE AMAZING WILDLIFE
FROM A SAFARI VEHICLE
Every turn in the road brings a new delight: a leopard that melts into the bush, warthog piglets trotting behind their mother, a whole herd of elephants at a waterhole.
Kruger’s game drives are for guests who want to get closer to the wildlife side of nature and experience the Park’s fauna up close.

Accommodation | Skukuza Safari Lodge
Skip to content
CREATE UNFORGETTABLE
MEMORIES
Experience the wonderful wildlife from a safari vehicle with helpful
guides interpreting the sights, sounds and signs of the bush.
Your Journey starts here
|
LUXURY & ELEGANT
ACCOMMODATION
|
Welcome to Skukuza Safari Lodge, where comfort meets environmental responsibility. Choose from our range of accommodations, including 91 standard rooms, 22 family rooms, 7 universally accessible rooms (wheelchair-friendly), and 8 luxury suites.
We prioritise sustainability by incorporating green building initiatives, adhering to international best practices. From energy efficiency to responsible waste management, we minimise our ecological footprint while ensuring your comfort.
Beyond our lodge, we actively contribute to community benefaction through economic opportunities in construction and operation. By involving local communities, we support growth and prosperity in the area.
Join us in creating a greener future while experiencing exceptional accommodations and thrilling safaris. Book your stay at Skukuza Safari Lodge and be part of our commitment to your satisfaction, the environment, and the local community.

AT THE LODGE
Sisonke Bar and Veranda
Relax and unwind in the beautifully decorated Sisonke Bar, where you can enjoy a refreshing beverage. Alternatively, take a seat on the veranda, offering picturesque views of the gardens, pool, and magnificent Baobab tree.
Mooka Outdoor Area
Experience the vibrant atmosphere of the Mooka Outdoor Area. Overlooking the gardens, this functional outdoor entertainment section is perfect for private events, parties, and small functions.
Swimming Pool
Take a dip in the sparkling blue pool on a warm bushveld day.
Located next to the gym, our swimming pool is perfect for both training and recreational swimming.
LUXURY
SUITES
Each suite offers a spacious lounge area to unwind and relax. Enjoy a restful sleep on two double beds with plush bedding. Refresh yourself in the large bathroom, complete with a bathtub and walk-in shower.
Step out onto your private patio from the bedroom or lounge, and immerse yourself in the serene ambiance of birdcalls and warm breezes.
Our luxury suites provide an elegant retreat, combining aesthetics with unmatched comfort. Indulge in the epitome of luxury at Skukuza Safari Lodge and create unforgettable memories in the heart of the African wilderness.
Amenities include:
Kitchenette with bar fridge
Coffee Machine
Guest toilet
Four-seater dining table
Wi-Fi
Two Satellite TVs (limited channels)
Two double beds
Bathroom with bathtub and shower
Private patio with table and chairs
Air conditioning
Electronic safe box
Desk and chair
STANDARD
ROOMS
Experience the captivating aesthetics of Africa in our 91 beautifully decorated standard rooms. Each room is designed with your comfort and convenience in mind. Enjoy a restful sleep on a king-size bed or two single twin beds with plush bedding in the spacious bedroom. Freshen up in the bathroom with a convenient walk-in shower.
Step out onto your private patio from the bedroom and immerse yourself in the serene melodies of birdcalls, the gentle afternoon breeze, and the enchanting sounds of wildlife.
We also offer 22 adjoining Family Rooms as well as 7 Universal Rooms (wheelchair-friendly), allowing you to enjoy the same features and amenities.
At Skukuza Safari Lodge, we prioritise your comfort and ensure that your accommodations provide an unforgettable experience amidst the enchanting beauty of the African wilderness.
Amenities include:
Bar fridge
Wi-Fi
Satellite TV (limited channels)
King-sized / Two single beds
Bathroom with walk-in shower
Private patio with table and chairs

Electronic safe box
Desk and chair
ACCOMMODATION
MAP
FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE WE ALSO OFFER
Experience the exceptional facilities at Skukuza Safari Lodge, where we strive to provide you with a seamless and enjoyable stay.
Bank
For your convenience, an FNB service branch is located at the Reception complex, providing banking services.
Fuel Station
The Total Service Station, located at the entrance of Skukuza Rest Camp, offers petrol, diesel, and a car wash facility.
Post Office
A Post Office is conveniently situated at the Reception complex, allowing you to handle your postal needs easily.
Medical Doctors
Should you require medical assistance, medical doctors are available for consultations at offices within Skukuza Rest Camp.
Shop
Visit the Park Shop in Skukuza Rest Camp for all your shopping needs. From groceries and treats to alcoholic beverages, curios, toiletries, photographic equipment, clothing, and books, you ll find a wide range of items to choose from.
Concierge Service
Our dedicated concierge service is here to assist you with personalised support. From arranging transportation to planning activities, our team is ready to ensure your stay is hassle-free.
